items.description:
Pure Skin & Body is a beauty salon in Kenridge Centre, Durbanville, established by Heidi in 1995. Visitors are welcomed by therapists Heidi and Jeanine, who trained at Isa Carstens Academy, and Maritza, who studied at the College of Cape Town. The salon describes itself as a place of relaxation, elegance and class.

Services include massages, waxing, manicures, pedicures, gel nails, facials, microneedling and male grooming, aimed at enhancing each client's natural beauty with a quality range of treatments. Heidi can also assist German and Italian speaking clients. The salon trades Tuesday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, closed Sundays and Mondays. It suits clients in Kenridge and Durbanville who want an established, personally run salon.

Randy Warthog Bar & Grill is a backpacker-style bar and grill on Main Road in Green Point, open from 07:00 until midnight daily. Its site calls it Cape Town's best backpacker bar, and it says everyone is welcome, whether a solo traveller, a student, a local or a group of friends.

The bar offers affordable drinks and meals with generous portions, along with a daily happy hour, specials and events. Its breakfast, lunch and dinner menus are built around value, so guests have cash left over for a few more drinks. The relaxed, social atmosphere suits travellers and locals who want an easy, budget-friendly night out in Green Point.

items.description:
Sams Hardware & Gas is a hardware store on Melkbos Street in Lentegeur, Mitchells Plain. Its own take.app storefront lists stock organised by category, covering general hardware, gas appliances, paint, electrical items and keys, along with plumbing supplies.

Customers can follow the shop's online storefront to be the first to know about new stock, product drops and promotions. Its product catalogue shows items such as cutting discs alongside everyday hardware lines. It suits residents of Lentegeur and Mitchells Plain who want hardware, plumbing, gas and electrical supplies from a local shop. Customers can browse the catalogue before visiting, which makes it easier to confirm an item is in stock ahead of a trip to the shop.

items.description:
SBG Cape Town is a martial arts gym with a location in Noordhoek, Cape Town, led by coach Steve Bazzea. The gym is affiliated with Straight Blast Gym International and practises a combination of Mixed Martial Arts, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, kickboxing for MMA and submission wrestling, following the coaching methodology of Matt Thornton and SBGi.

Classes are designed for people of all ages, backgrounds and goals, from aspiring MMA athletes and BJJ competitors to anyone in their fifties looking for a fun way to get fit. The gym also offers personal training, wellness and conditioning programmes alongside its martial arts curriculum, and it runs open mats on Fridays at 5:45pm. It suits beginners and experienced martial artists alike who want a structured, safe training environment in Noordhoek.

items.description:
Smartphone ER is a mobile phone repair shop in Westlake Shopping Centre, Westlake, Cape Town, with 28 years of experience in the repair industry at manufacturer level. The shop offers same-day emergency repairs for cracked screens and other cellphone faults, and it is an authorised Samsung customer service centre that uses only genuine Samsung parts.

The business also holds authorised partner status with MTN, Cell C and other brands, and it is an authorised Apple independent repair provider. For urgent cases, the team will travel to a customer's home or business within 8km of a service centre to fix the device on site. It suits customers who need a trusted, same-day repair on a cracked screen or other phone fault.

SPK Engineering Supplies is based on Paarden Eiland Road in Paardeneiland, Cape Town, and describes itself as a leading supplier of industrial and engineering products across Africa. The company says it aims to supply top quality products with an excellent choice of brands.

Its focus is on the local manufacturing and engineering industry, supplying cutting tools and machinery, and it also exports equipment to other countries. It suits manufacturers, engineering workshops and industrial customers who need a reliable local source of engineering tools and machinery. Its catalogue of pages shows a wide product range, reflecting the breadth of cutting tools and machinery the business carries for different engineering needs.

items.description:
The Lookout Hout Bay is a restaurant on the water's edge in Hout Bay Harbour, with views of Chapman's Peak and the Hout Bay coastline. From its wooden deck, diners can watch the working harbour's fishing fleets, deep-sea tuna charter boats and Seal Island sightseeing cruises while they eat.

The menu covers grilled seafood, sushi, oysters and cold drinks, alongside savoury meat dishes, and the restaurant describes its food as a culinary journey. It also runs specials and events through the year, from seasonal menu items to exclusive gatherings. It suits diners who want harbourside views alongside a varied seafood and grill menu in Hout Bay.

items.description:
TimBuild Somerset West is an independent hardware and building-materials store at the corner of Reitz and Victoria Streets in Somerset West, Cape Town. The business describes its specialities as precision cutting, edging, smart DIY cupboards, DIY kitchens, general DIY, hardware, timber, boards, building materials, cabinet fittings, paint and power tools.

The store serves contractors, cabinet makers and DIY enthusiasts, offering professional service, high-quality precision cutting, expert advice and on-time deliveries. Customers can request free quotes and arrange reliable delivery, and the store also offers accounts and payment options for regular customers. It suits tradespeople and home renovators who want cut-to-size boards and timber alongside general hardware supplies.

items.description:
Willem Hair Design is a hair salon at 88 13th Avenue in Boston, Bellville, Cape Town. Its Fresha profile describes it as a refined salon space where quality, creativity and individuality take centre stage, with a team that delivers precision haircuts and fashion-forward colour techniques tailored to a client's style and features.

Services and pricing shown on its booking page include haircuts and blow-dries, root colour touch-ups, balayage and ombre with a blow-dry, and sets of ten foil highlights with a cut and blow-dry. Clients can book appointments with stylists Henco or Willem directly through the salon's Fresha page. It suits clients in Boston and Bellville who want a precision cut or a colour change from a dedicated styling team.

Wine Concepts is a specialist wine, beer and spirits retailer in Cardiff Castle, Newlands, Cape Town. The store is owned and run by founder Mike Bampfield-Duggan, together with his team Renette, Niël and David, who are on hand to guide customers' wine choices or share a story about the wines they love.

The shop stocks an impressive selection of top South African wines, arranged by varietal, alongside spirits, beers and international wines with a special interest in French Champagne. Daily wine tastings run Mondays to Fridays from 4pm to 7pm and Saturdays from 12pm to 3pm. It suits wine lovers in Newlands who want expert advice and a chance to taste before they buy.

items.description:
Zone Fitness Westgate is a gym in Westgate Shopping Centre, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town, part of the Zone Fitness chain. The club has newly upgraded facilities, including enhanced cardio and weights areas and improved training spaces designed for all fitness levels.

The gym's electronic cardiovascular equipment supports training that raises the heart rate, and its dedicated team is positioned to support members through their fitness journey, whether the goal is building strength, improving endurance or simply staying active. It trades on weekdays from 05:30 to 21:00 or 20:00 on Fridays, and from 07:00 to 15:00 on weekends and public holidays. It suits members in Mitchells Plain who want modern gym equipment and a supportive team close to home.

306 Restaurant and Lounge is a Nigerian restaurant in Eclipse Park, Village Walk, Parklands, Cape Town, rated 4.7 from more than 500 reviews on Uber Eats. The menu includes dishes such as grilled catfish, ram suya, pap and akara, grilled turkey wing, and sides like goat meat, small fish, turkey and beef.

The restaurant also sells plantain chips, cashew nuts and kilishi, a traditional dried-meat Nigerian snack, alongside dry beans and plantain as side orders. It trades from 09:30 to 21:30, offering pick-up service, though delivery through the platform is not always available. It suits diners looking for Nigerian dishes and West African snacks in the Parklands area.

items.description:
Anysberg Biltong & Deli is a food retail group specialising in biltong, droewors and delicatessen products, with a branch in De Ville Shopping Centre in Durbanville, Cape Town. The business says its products are made with passion and finesse, aiming to offer customers the best.

Its meat comes from leading abattoirs in Southern Africa, and the company says its food hygiene standards are among the best in the industry, using only the best cuts for its delicate products. The listing describes the business as proud of its quality control from sourcing through to the finished product. It suits customers who want beef, game, ostrich or chicken biltong and droewors made to a high standard.

Artappel Prop Hire is a prop and furniture rental company based in the Transnet Industrial Park on Voortrekker Road in Salt River, Cape Town. Its online catalogue lets customers search for a prop by category, with a huge range spanning furniture, decor and specialist items.

Stock categories include bar furniture, beds, bicycles, carpets of various sizes, several kinds of chairs, children's toys, clocks, computers, cooler boxes, couches, lighting in several styles, luggage, mirrors, musical equipment, office furniture, parasols, patio sets, pictures and art in multiple sizes, and plant pots, among many others. The sheer breadth of categories shows the scale of the rental stock available for film, TV and event productions. It suits production companies, event planners and stylists who need props and furniture hired for a shoot or event in Cape Town.

items.description:
Bluebottle Guesthouse is a seven-room guesthouse in Muizenberg, Cape Town, that can accommodate up to 16 guests. Five of the rooms on the upper level open onto an upper balcony, and two open onto a lower balcony, with each room offering ocean, lake or mountain views.

Each room is named after a butterfly from the 'blues' family and is individually decorated and serviced daily. All but one room have en-suite bathrooms, with that one room having a separate bathroom instead. The guesthouse describes its rooms, such as the spacious Cape Blue room with extra beds for children, and the Fig Tree room with its own separate bathroom and views. It suits guests who want individually styled rooms with sea or mountain views in Muizenberg.

Body+Mind Wellness Spa is a day spa on the second floor of the Sea Point Medical Centre on Kloof Road in Sea Point, Cape Town. The spa describes its approach as bringing rejuvenation of the mind and restoration of the body together in harmony, with a focus on self-care and pampering.

Its treatments include massage therapy, facials, waxing and manicure and pedicure treatments, offered in what the spa calls a haven of beauty and wellness designed to help clients escape daily stresses. The spa is open every day of the week, from 9am to 7pm. It suits clients in Sea Point who want a range of spa treatments in a calm, dedicated space.

Bornman & Hayward Attorneys is a law firm based in Stellenberg, Bellville, Cape Town, practising as attorneys, notaries, conveyancers and mediators. The firm's directors and staff say they pride themselves on providing quality legal solutions with integrity and efficiency, built on loyalty to clients and to one another.

Its practice areas include conveyancing, general notarial services such as marriage contracts and trusts, drafting deeds of sale and registering property transfers, township registrations and property developments, labour law and industrial relations, employment litigation, CCMA and bargaining council matters, and broader litigation covering liquidation, sequestration, construction disputes and rental evictions. It suits individuals and businesses who need conveyancing, labour law or litigation handled by one firm in the northern suburbs.

items.description:
Cafe Orca is a casual-dining seafood restaurant in a beach cottage on the beachfront of Melkbosstrand, Cape Town, with what it calls some of the best views the area has to offer. Guests can dine on the beachfront patio or inside the cottage, and the business has been serving the area for more than 25 years.

The menu runs from local mussels, calamari and prawn starters through to freshly caught line fish, with Eat Out quoted as saying that at this restaurant all the fish tastes delightfully different, unlike some seafood spots where every dish tastes the same. The kitchen aims to keep improving its atmosphere, service and menu over time. It suits diners who want fresh, locally sourced seafood with sea views in Melkbosstrand.

items.description:
Cape of Storms Distilling Company is a craft rum distillery and tasting room at The Spice Yard in Salt River, Cape Town. The distillery says it is pioneering a new rum-making method in South Africa, combining a centuries-old Caribbean technique with naturally strong African blackstrap molasses.

Its rum is produced in small batches to protect quality and flavour, and it contains no added sugar, so drinkers get the taste without the extra sweetness. The company controls the process from fermentation through to bottling, which it says lets it deliver a smooth, full-flavoured spirit. It positions itself as part of a wave of craft spirits in South Africa, following the rise of craft gin and beer. It suits visitors who want to taste or tour a small-batch rum distillery in Salt River.

items.description:
Chart Farm is a pick-your-own rose farm and farm stall near Wynberg Park in Cape Town, purchased by the current family in 1934 and still run by them. The farm has more than 12 hectares of arable land, with an English-style rose garden, grape vines and lemon trees.

Chart Farm says it is the only place in the Cape Peninsula where visitors can select and pick their own roses. Alongside the rose garden, the farm has a farmstall, a coffee shop that requires bookings, and horse riding with panoramic views stretching to False Bay. Both the coffee shop and farmstall trade from 9am to 4pm. It suits visitors who want a countryside outing, fresh produce or a rose garden walk close to the Southern Suburbs.

Classic Bakery is an award-winning bakery on Thornton Road in Crawford, Cape Town, that has been in business for more than 16 years. The bakery supplies excellent quality products at affordable prices and bakes to customer specifications, working from a client's own illustrations or designs.

Its specialities include multi-tier wedding cakes, engagement cakes, 21st birthday cakes and novelty cakes, alongside cakes for any other occasion customers wish to celebrate. All goods are freshly baked the traditional way, and the bakery says it never uses pre-mixes, so clients always get fresh, tasty products that represent true value for money. It also offers unique and traditional products that few other bakeries can match. It suits customers who want a custom-designed celebration cake or everyday fresh baking in Crawford.
